english_text: . Labour MEPs welcome today 's agreement on nutrition and health labelling of foods . We accept that this is a compromise package and there are some elements , particularly on Amendment 66 , where we have reservations . We would have preferred the common position text , which allowed no derogations . However , the new law represents a major step forward in food labelling for consumers and improves the overall regulatory framework . It is on this basis that we supported the compromise package .
